text: What if you never stopped shrinking?
Ten times smaller, every few seconds.
Eighteen centimeters. Your cat is now the size of an elephant.
Under two centimeters. The carpet is a jungle.
A hundred eighty microns. A dust mite is bigger than you. It's staring.
Eighteen microns. One flake of your dead skin is twice your size.
Under two microns. You're bacteria-sized. They want to be friends.
A hundred eighty nanometers. Light waves are taller than you.
Two nanometers. DNA is as wide as you.
Zero point two nanometers. You're the size of a single atom.
How small would you go? Part three: inside the atom.
